description: This file contains utility functions for subtitle correction, integrating RAG retrieval with LLM calls to improve subtitle text accuracy while maintaining timing information. It provides functions for correcting subtitles using external retrieval and language models, as well as applying these corrections to subtitle entries.

methods.name: Tuple[List[str],List[List[Dict[str,Any]]]] correct_subtitles_with_llm( subtitle_entries: List[SubtitleEntry], transcript_entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], fmt: str = "srt", k: int = 10, )
methods.description: Corrects subtitle cues using an LLM with RAG context, returning corrected texts and associated RAG results.

methods.name: List[SubtitleEntry] apply_corrected_texts( subtitle_entries: List[SubtitleEntry], corrected_texts: List[str], )
methods.description: Creates new subtitle entries with corrected text while preserving original timing.

ctags.signature: ( subtitle_entries: List[SubtitleEntry], transcript_entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], fmt: str = "srt", k: int = 10, )
